higher-static-blast-tiers.head: e4c34958
higher-static-blast-tiers.scope: Matched native runs exercised both tiers. The prior a0f66e2c run verified selection refusal, neutral damage and timers; the fixture retest verified selected resistance with no target or gameplay changes for admitted casts. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/833#issuecomment-7086741780

damage.source: GOB 590 stores a fixed 32-point viral health modifier. Typed mitigation is applied after the Coder source influence.
damage.runtime: AbilityHandler selects the fixed GOB value before the incomplete legacy CSV bounds. AbilityTargets and TypedAbilityResistance apply the ordinary selected-target damage path.
damage.test: StaticBlastTiersUseTheirFixedViralBaseAndOwnAndGroupReuse and coder-static-blast-tiers-server cover raw 32 and the live outputs. Stock did 39 neutral and 32 with +43 Viral Resistance. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/833#issuecomment-7086741780 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/833#issuecomment-7086921777

targeting.source: GOB 590 requires a live selected hostile in its 16 metre range.
targeting.runtime: The selected-Coder gate checks ownership and target class before debit, locks the original view/spawn through the cast, and uses the common landing path.
targeting.test: DelayedHostileCastCannotLandOnANewerSpawnInTheOriginalView and the live server replay cover stale/range/refusal. PR833 stock excludes no-target, ally and the 17 m target, then deals damage only to the selected NPC or player. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/833#issuecomment-7086741780 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/833#issuecomment-7086921777

source-parity.source: The fixed GOB 32 replaces the unsupported generic 50–80 CSV range.
source-parity.runtime: The ordinary Coder Style influence and typed resistance policy are retained for legal casts.
source-parity.test: Stock neutral 39 and resisted 32 match the executable path. The documented typed resistance curve is the current server policy. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/833#issuecomment-7086741780 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/833#issuecomment-7086921777

behavior-tests.source: GOB 590 stores 18 IS, 2 s cast, 6 s own reuse, and group 683 with a 4 s timer.
behavior-tests.runtime: The selected hostile and the sourced damage both run through ordinary AbilityHandler admission, cast and cooldown handling.
behavior-tests.test: StaticBlastTiersUseTheirFixedViralBaseAndOwnAndGroupReuse, the complete server replay and both stock runs verify cost and timers, selected damage, surrounding player exclusion and the resistance comparison. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/833#issuecomment-7086741780 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/833#issuecomment-7086921777
